hypothesis: Constrain original independent-extrema stress to contemporaneously observed five-minute mark-move/execution-gap pairs. This is a weaker empirical stress assumption, not a correction of an established bug or a learned edge.
clock: Original HEADROOM is rolling intraday: at each completed minute close t, require 43201 genuine mark endpoints in [t-30DAY,t] and 43200 completed open bars through t-MINUTE. It is not anchored to midnight or thirty completed UTC calendar days.
source_indexing: Input times[i]=trade minute OPEN x_i; marks[i]=mark close P(x_i+MINUTE); opens[i]=TradeOpen(x_i). Current decision t=x_i+MINUTE.
pair: For v=x_j, a_j=log(marks[j-1]/marks[j-6])=log(P(v)/P(v-5MINUTE)); g_j=log(opens[j]/marks[j-1])=log(TradeOpen(v)/P(v)). P(v) strictly precedes modeled fill v+1us. Require completed open bar v+MINUTE<=t, and v-5MINUTE>=t-30DAY.
pair_population: j in [i-43200+6,i], inclusive; 43195 observations. Legacy independent move population has 43196 observations and includes its last move ending at current close t. That last move has no completed own open yet; candidate excludes it rather than borrowing another gap or reading a future open.
fixed_mechanical_controls: Three source discriminators are reported: original legacy-independent HEADROOM; aligned-independent maxima computed over exactly the same 43195 a_j/g_j observations as paired; and the sole paired candidate. Legacy-minus-aligned separates endpoint/alignment effects, aligned-minus-paired isolates coupling effects. Do not attribute all legacy/paired trigger differences to coupling.
clipping: Within each observation, LONG a=min(a_j,0),g=min(g_j,0); SHORT a=max(a_j,0),g=max(g_j,0). Then calculate each paired hurdle and take its maximum, including neutral a=g=0. Never maximize a and g separately in the candidate.
formula: For direction s=sign(q), r=exp(a), f=r*exp(g)*(1-s*.0008), K_s=max_pairs[.005*r+abs(f-r)+.00055*f-s*(r-1)]. At READY completed close, own q!=0 and own current isolated equity E <= abs(q)*current_own_mark*K_s triggers. Same original maintenance/cost arithmetic and inclusive boundary; float64 source discriminator, not a new Decimal account implementation.
exact_sufficient_statistic: After direction clipping, the original scenario deficit is abs(q)*P(t)*K_pair-E, where K_pair depends only on historical paired ratios and direction. Therefore two rolling maxima K_LONG and K_SHORT are exact algebraic sufficient statistics for any current own q/E/P(t); original monotone deque computes each in O(N), assessment O(1). No scenario sampling, approximation, frontier truncation or per-minute43195-scenario rescanning. Floating arithmetic grouping differs from original but formula is algebraically identical; synthetic direct original-assess brute force verifies the result within numerical roundoff, without an epsilon in the trigger.
nonfinite_scalar_refusal: Finite current operands can still overflow abs(q)*mark*K or E-required. If an invested scalar has a finite selected READY hurdle but nonfinite required equity or headroom, raise ValueError; never interpret inf as a trigger. Final trigger also requires finite headroom, preserving the original finiteness guard. No numerical epsilon or historical-domain bound is introduced.
readiness: Call byte-identical original features() for READY/reason. Preserve exact full-window bad mark, derived/unknown mark, bad completed trade open and noncontiguous clock behavior. NOT_READY produces no additional signal and NaN paired hurdles; no interpolation, shorter warmup, missing-as-zero, historical source or mask repair.
known_limitation: Constrained joint observed scenarios can miss unseen co-occurring extremes that independent maxima conservatively cover. This weakens/constrains the stress assumption, but general required-equity coefficient ordering is not promised: an extreme positive-price LONG gap counterexample exists because maintenance varies with stressed mark. No new bounds or clipping are introduced to force ordering. Removed alerts are not labeled false positives using subsequent PnL. Source-only distinction does not certify safety, economic value or native exchange rules.
